name: Florida Ebike Rentals
tagline: Find e-bike rentals, guided tours and beach cruisers across Florida
description: Florida Ebike Rentals is a free directory of electric bike rental shops, guided e-bike tours and beach cruiser rentals across Florida, from 30A and the Emerald Coast to the Florida Keys.

promoBanner._comment: One entry per offer. With more than one the strip slide-rotates through them every rotateSeconds. Every link is rendered rel="sponsored nofollow noopener"; any href that is not http(s) is dropped at build.

map._comment: Maps are switched off site-wide (enabled: false) - flip it back to true to return every map with no other change. Tile provider settings below are kept for that. OpenStreetMap's own tile.openstreetmap.org is NOT usable here: its usage policy forbids heavy use of the volunteer-run servers and requires an identifying Referer. Carto's basemaps are keyless and permit use with attribution. For higher volume move to a keyed provider (MapTiler, Stadia, Thunderforest) by pasting its URL template below, including the key.
